sessions.notes: Warm-up 400m easy. Main: 8×100m on CSS+10s focusing on high-elbow catch and early vertical forearm. Cool-down 200m easy. Total ~1400m.
Zone 2 only. Conversational pace — if you can't speak in full sentences you're too hard. Cadence goal: 170+ spm.
Flat to rolling terrain. Stay Zone 2 the entire ride. Cadence 85-95 rpm. Drink every 15 min.
Warm-up 300m. Main: 5×300m at CSS+5s with 45s rest. Cool-down 200m. Total ~2000m.
Rolling terrain. Aerobic base ride, target Zone 2-3. Practice eating and drinking on the bike. Stay seated on climbs.
Easy long run. Zone 2. Last 5 minutes gradually build to race pace to prime legs.
Warm-up 400m. Main: 10×100m at CSS+5s with 20s rest. Cool-down 200m. Total ~1800m.
10 min easy warm-up. 20 min at tempo pace (Zone 3-4, comfortably hard). 10 min easy cool-down.
Warm-up 15 min. Main: 4×8 min at threshold (Zone 4) with 4 min easy recovery. Cool-down 15 min.
Drills focus: catch-up drill, fingertip drag, 6-1-6 kick. Then 6×50m at sprint effort with full recovery.
Posterior chain and hip stability. 3×10 deadlifts, hip thrusts, step-ups. 3×30s side planks, dead bugs. Focus on glute activation.
45 min ride at Zone 3 effort, immediately off bike into a 20 min run at Zone 3. Practice T2 transition. Note how legs feel in first 5 min of run.
Easy Zone 2 run. No pace target. Build aerobic base. Run by feel.
Easy technique only. No intervals. Focus on feel of the water. Total ~1000m at comfortable pace.
Very easy spin. Zone 1-2 only. Legs should feel fresh by the end. No pushing.
Easy 35 min run. Zone 2 max. Leave feeling good, not tired.
Warm-up 400m. Main: 8×100m at CSS with 25s rest, then 4×50m sprint with full recovery. Cool-down 200m.
2×15 min at tempo pace with 5 min easy between. Finish strong on the second rep.
Zone 2 aerobic ride. Longer than usual to build volume. Cadence 90 rpm.
Warm-up 400m. Main: 4×200m at sprint tri race pace with 60s rest. Cool-down 200m. Feel the effort and practice sighting every 10 strokes.
Posterior chain focus. Banded clamshells, RDLs, step-ups, Copenhagen planks. Keep intensity moderate — performance day tomorrow.
Hilly route. Keep power steady uphill. Zone 2-3. Fuel every 30 min. This is your longest ride of the block.
Longest run of the block. Zone 2. Focus on relaxed form, especially in the last 15 min when fatigued.
